description: 看不到对方表情的电话最容易慌。练熟改时间的流程，语气稳、信息全。

targetChunks.en: Hi, I'm calling to reschedule my appointment.
targetChunks.zh: 你好，我想改一下预约时间。
targetChunks.note: reschedule 一个词顶一整句，电话里开门见山最省事。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Hi, I'm calling to reschedule my appointment on Thursday.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——你好，我想改一下周四的预约。

targetChunks.note: 不想解释细节时最常用，对方一般不会再追问。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Something came up at work. Can we move it?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——工作上临时有事。能改个时间吗？

targetChunks.en: I'm sorry, I can't make it on Thursday.
targetChunks.note: make it 是“赶到、能来”，比 I can't go 自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — I'm sorry, I can't make it on Thursday. Is Friday possible?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——抱歉，周四我来不了。周五可以吗？

targetChunks.en: Could we move it to Friday afternoon?
targetChunks.note: move it to + 时间，改时间最直接的说法。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Could we move it to Friday afternoon? — Let me check.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——能改到周五下午吗？——我看一下。

targetChunks.en: Would tomorrow morning work for you?
targetChunks.note: work for you 是“对你合适”，比 Is it OK 更礼貌。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Would tomorrow morning work for you? — Ten o'clock is fine.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——明天上午你们方便吗？——十点可以。

targetChunks.note: earlier / later 可以直接接在 anything 后面，很实用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Do you have anything earlier? — We have one at nine.

targetChunks.note: 电话里争取时间的过渡句，比沉默好。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Let me check my schedule. Friday afternoon works for me.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——我看一下日程。周五下午可以。

targetChunks.note: 比 OK 更自然，电话里确认时间常用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Three thirty? — That works for me.

targetChunks.en: Could you put me on the waitlist?
targetChunks.zh: 能把我放进候补名单吗？
targetChunks.note: 想约的时间满了时说，比反复打过去省事。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — If anyone cancels, could you put me on the waitlist?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——如果有人取消，能把我放进候补吗？

targetChunks.note: 电话结束前一定做一次确认，避免记错。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Can I confirm the time? So that's Friday at three thirty?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——我确认一下时间，是周五三点半对吗？

targetChunks.note: 改期前问清楚，避免之后账单上多一笔。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Is there a cancellation fee if I change it again?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——如果我再次改期，要收取消费吗？

targetChunks.en: Sorry, the line is breaking up.
targetChunks.note: 电话听不清专用句，比 I can't hear you 更地道。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Sorry, the line is breaking up. Could you repeat that?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——抱歉，信号断断续续的。能再说一遍吗？

roleplay.promptZh: 你打电话给牙医诊所，想把周四的预约改到周五下午。说明原因，确认新时间，问清是否收费。
roleplay.promptEn: Call the dental clinic to move your Thursday appointment to Friday afternoon. Explain, confirm the new time, and ask about fees.
goals: 开场直接说明要改预约
给出替代时间并确认对方是否方便
电话结束前复述确认时间与费用

script.speaker: staff
script.en: Good morning, Riverside Dental. How can I help?
script.zh: 早上好，河畔牙科。有什么可以帮您？

script.speaker: you
script.en: Hi, I'm calling to reschedule my appointment on Thursday.
script.zh: 你好，我想改一下周四的预约。

script.speaker: staff
script.en: Of course. What day works better for you?

script.speaker: you
script.en: Something came up at work. Would Friday afternoon work?
script.zh: 工作上临时有事。周五下午方便吗？

script.speaker: staff
script.en: We have three thirty or four fifteen.
script.zh: 我们有三点半或者四点十五。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Three thirty works for me. Is there a cancellation fee?
script.zh: 三点半可以。改期要收费吗？

script.speaker: staff
script.en: No, since you're giving us two days' notice.
script.zh: 不用，因为您提前两天通知了。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Great. So just to confirm, Friday at three thirty?
script.zh: 好的。确认一下，周五三点半？
